references.text: Fire went out from the Lord's presence and consumed the burnt offering on the altar. This shows the positive side of God's fire that consumes the sacrifice, in contrast to the judgment in 10:2.
Nadab and Abihu died before the Lord when they offered unauthorized fire. This verse refers directly back to the event in Leviticus 10:2.
Nadab and Abihu died when they offered unauthorized fire before the Lord. A genealogical reference that recalls their death.
Fire went out from the Lord and consumed the 250 men who were offering incense. The same kind of divine judgment by fire.
Mentions Nadab and Abihu, who died before their father, a reference to their early death described in Leviticus 10:2.
The Lord made fire and sulfur rain down on Sodom and Gomorrah. Divine judgment by fire from the Lord.
Our God is a consuming fire. Describes God's holiness and the nature of his judgment.
Prohibition against offering unauthorized incense on the altar of incense. The sin of Nadab and Abihu was linked to unauthorized fire/incense.
